title: Probing cosmic anisotropy from galaxy clusters via the dipole fitting method
summary: The cosmological principle, as the cornerstone of the standard cosmological model, requires that the universe be homogeneous and isotropic on large scales. As a fundamental assumption, it is constantly subjected to testing via various datasets and methods. In this work, we used the dipole fitting (DF) method to correct the logarithmic luminosity ($\log{L_{X}}$) of galaxy clusters, search for cosmic anisotropic signals, and establish a statistical isotropic analysis scheme.
